data.summary: MusterFit Studios GmbH confirms your "Flex Premium" gym membership starting 1 March 2026. The minimum term is 12 months at €34.90 per month.
data.explanation: This letter confirms your gym contract. It runs for a minimum of 12 months from 1 March 2026 at €34.90 per month, debited monthly in advance by direct debit. To end it at the end of the minimum term, you must give 1 month's notice. After that it continues indefinitely and can be cancelled at any time with 1 month's notice. You can cancel with the cancellation button in the app or by e-mail. The app calculates the notice deadline for you. No action is needed now.
